description: Undo a reply the user just sent to a message from Moneda. Only call this when the user asks to undo, and only within 10 seconds of sending (until the reply's `undoableUntil`); afterwards it fails with "too late". The reply and its document are deleted and the message asks for a reply again.

replyId.description: Id of the reply, from reply_to_moneda_message.

name: undo_message_reply
